entities.summary: Emi Palmor is an Israeli lawyer and senior civil servant who served as the Director General of the Ministry of Justice from 1 February 2014 to September 2019. During her 24 years of civil service, she was appointed time and again by the government to chair public committees concerning sensitive and controversial social and legal issues in Israeli society, which she led to sustainable resolutions. Palmor is recognized for applying methods of civic engagement and participation in Government processes of policy design, and for promoting a holistic approach to public policy, focusing on prevention and education plans rather than legislation and law enforcement.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: Emi Palmor's work on promoting holistic public policy and civic engagement has had a significant impact in Israeli society, particularly through her chairmanship of public committees addressing sensitive social issues. Her approach has led to sustainable resolutions and prevention-focused policies.
